jobs.job_description:
We are seeking an experienced and solutions-focused Computer Systems Administrator to lead and manage our school’s ICT operations and team. This is an exciting opportunity for an ICT professional to provide strategic advice, strengthen technology services and ensure staff and students have reliable, effective ICT systems to support teaching, learning and school operations. We are looking for an ICT professional who combines technical expertise with strong leadership, communication and problem-solving skills.

About us:

Kingston State College is a leading co-educational independent public school in Logan, supporting students across Years 7-12 through its High School and Kingston Learning College. With a strong focus on personalised learning, the College provides flexible opportunities to meet individual student needs and welcomes enrolments from across the community. Guided by the motto “Progress with Pride”, the College promotes a positive culture built on Commitment, Courtesy, Cooperation and Common Sense. With a philosophy of “Nothing left to Chance”, staff work collaboratively to support every student's academic, social and emotional development and prepare them for successful pathways into employment, apprenticeships, traineeships and further education.

Your opportunity:

  • Lead and manage the Information and Communication Technology (ICT) team and ICT operations of the school to ensure that the day-to-day aspects of the school's ICT systems are managed professionally and align with departmental priorities.

Responsibilities:

  • ICT leadership: Provide strategic advice and lead the school's ICT team and operations.
  • Technology: Implement innovative ICT solutions and maintain school systems.
  • Team management: Supervise, train and manage ICT staff, workflows and performance.
  • Technical support: Ensure high-quality support, troubleshooting, maintenance and repairs.
  • Policies & compliance: Follow relevant legislation, departmental policies and safety requirements.
  • Procurement: Manage ICT purchasing, hardware and software procurement.
  • Systems management: Install, maintain and improve ICT and educational systems.
  • Asset management: Manage ICT assets, registers, disposal and annual stocktake.
  • Resources: Manage human, financial and physical resources effectively.
  • Administration: Maintain equipment registers, databases, spreadsheets and reports.
  • Continuous improvement: Review ICT services, procedures and work practices.

Interested? To Apply: 

  • Attach a brief resume including contact details for 2 referees (referees should have an understanding of your relevant work history)
  • Attach a 2-page written statement about how your achievements and capabilities meet the requirements of the role.
  • Attach a copy of your mandatory qualifications/registration outlined in the attached role description.

We welcome all applicants to share any support needed to ensure our recruitment process is inclusive.Applications remain current for 12 months from the closing date and may be considered for appointment to identical or similar vacancies within the Department.Applications from recruitment agencies will not be accepted.

Company Description

Are you ready to be a big part of something big?

At Machines4U machinery part of carsales, we’re all about making buying and selling a great experience. We’ve been evolving with the new economy to help people choose how they move today and tomorrow.

When it comes to your career, we want to offer meaningful opportunities that empower you to make a lasting impact. But for that to happen, we strive to feel small, small enough to stay agile, learn across teams, and connect authentically with each other.

With a vision to be the global leader in online vehicle marketplaces, we’re transforming how people buy and sell across the world. We discover new ideas and bring them to life. We continue to grow, and we continue to evolve and we’re not afraid to take bold steps to get there.

A career in Software Engineering will see you working on products that are used every single day by our millions of customers all over the world. This position is within our ACIL (Auto, Corporate, Industry & Leisure) team. The team focuses on high availability product for Dealership customers to buy and sell their inventory. It plays a vital role in allowing them to maximise their online customer interaction and sale funnels.

We embrace hybrid working combining the flexibility of remote work with the energy and connection of in-person collaboration. We champion flexibility and offer a range of policies and leave options to support your wellbeing.

What’s on offer

  • Recognition as one of Australia’s Best Workplaces™ by Great Place to Work®, a Family Friendly Workplace, a WORK180 endorsed employer.
  • A highly engaged, collaborative team where you’ll learn from exceptional talent.
  • 24 weeks paid parental leave for primary caregivers, four weeks for secondary caregivers, and six weeks paid gender-affirming care leave.
  • Regular hackathons, continuous learning opportunities, and wellbeing initiatives that support your mental, emotional, and physical health.
Job Description

What you’ll be doing

  • Own engineering execution for Machines4U, from product development and platform reliability to engineering practices and delivery cadence
  • Translate business priorities set by senior leadership into a clear, sequenced engineering roadmap and deliver against it
  • Lead a high-performing, distributed engineering team, and hold the behavioural and technical bar
  • Partner closely with product and carsales engineering counterparts to shape the Machines4U technology landscape and ensure engineering decisions serve commercial outcomes
  • Lead the progressive modernisation of Machines4U’s technology stack, balancing legacy platform stability with migration to scalable, secure and group-aligned modern systems.
  • Oversee key platform integrations and third-party technical dependencies, ensuring reliable interfaces across marketplace, CRM, payments, marketing, reporting and group systems.
  • Own engineering input into security, reliability and compliance practices, ensuring risks are understood, prioritised and remediated pragmatically.
  • Actively contribute to engineering practices, tooling, and culture across the carsales Engineering community
  • Provide clear, credible engineering perspectives to senior leadership, including assessments of risk, trade-offs, and capacity
Qualifications

What we're looking for

  • Proven experience leading engineering teams in a product-led, commercially-driven environment, ideally in a marketplace or B2B SaaS context
  • Strong technical depth across modern web stacks (backend and frontend), cloud infrastructure, and API design
  • Track record delivering practical engineering roadmaps that move the needle on business outcomes
  • Experience operating in a mixed legacy and modern technology environment, with a pragmatic approach to modernisation and risk reduction.
  • Natural relationship builder who can work effectively across functions, holding your own with stakeholders while staying accountable to a broader group
  • Credible operating range: from coding standards and incident response to roadmap trade-offs and senior leadership updates
  • Hands-on enough to review architecture, unblock engineers, and spot quality problems early
  • Pragmatic experience balancing delivery pace and meeting standards for security, reliability, and scalability

We know not everyone will meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If you’re excited about the role and believe you can make a difference, we’d love to hear from you.

Additional Information

A few other things we want you to know...

  • As an equal opportunity employer, Machines4U and carsales welcomes applications from individuals of all backgrounds, identities, abilities, and life experiences. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and supported.
  • If you have a disability or require adjustments to participate fully in the recruitment process, please let us know - we’re here to support you.
  • We understand the importance of work-life balance and offer flexible working arrangements, including part-time options. If you’d like to explore this, just ask during the process.
  • We’re also a proud Circle Back Initiative employer, which means we commit to responding to every applicant.
  • Successful candidates joining the Machines4U and carsales team will need to complete a National Police Record check and must have full-time Australian working rights.

So come and join our team - because every role is a big role in our plans to go big.

We are looking for a curious and motivated Junior Software Engineer with an interest in AI, data analytics and automation to help develop practical business solutions that improve reporting, decision-making and operational efficiency.

Embedded with the Software Engineering team, this is a hands-on role focused on AI workflows, data analysis, automation and business intelligence. It is not a social media or content-writing role.

What you'll do

  • Develop and improve AI prompts and workflows.
  • Transform Excel, CSV and other business data into useful reports, dashboards and summaries.
  • Help automate repetitive business and compliance processes.
  • Build AI tools that help managers understand business performances.
  • Assist in the development of AI agents that monitor areas such as:
    • Safety and Compliance
    • Operations
    • Finance
    • Customer Experience
    • Driver Performance
  • Help identify data quality issues and problems within reporting systems.
  • Use AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot to assist with SQL, Power BI, DAX, Python and documentation.
  • Test AI outputs to ensure they are accurate, reliable and fit for purpose.
  • Document processes so they can be easily used by other staff.
  • Work closely with Compliance and business teams.
  • Contribute to projects involving:
    • Vehicle maintenance forecasting and asset optimisation analytics
    • AI-powered executive reporting
    • AI-assisted decision support
    • Business process automation

What we're looking for

Essential

Applicants should meet one of the following criteria:

  • 1-2 years of relevant industry experience; or
  • Final-year undergraduate student; or
  • Master's student in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Analytics, Business Analytics, Engineering, or a related discipline.

In addition, you should have:

  • Strong Excel skills.
  • Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail.
  • A genuine interest in AI, automation and data.
  • The ability to work independently and take ownership of projects.

  • Python
  • SQL
  • Power BI and DAX
  • Microsoft Fabric
  • PySpark
  • Azure AI / Azure OpenAI
  • Copilot Studio
  • Machine Learning

  • REST APIs

You don't need experience with all these technologies. We are looking for someone who is curious, analytical and willing to learn.

  • AI-powered executive Q&A
  • Automated reporting and commentary

These projects may later expand into predictive analytics, AI agents and more advanced automation solutions.

Why Join Us?

This is an opportunity to build real AI solutions that will be used across the business.

You will have the opportunity to learn, take ownership and make a measurable difference while developing valuable skills in AI, automation, data analytics and business intelligence.

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, experiences and perspectives.

If you enjoy managing software projects, coordinating work across different teams and keeping delivery on track, this role offers plenty of variety. MaxSoft is a remote-first Australian software company supporting the strata management industry. We are looking for someone who is experienced in software project delivery, steady under pressure, clear in communication and comfortable working with both technical and non-technical teams.

This role combines software project delivery, internal business projects and process improvement. You will work closely with product owners, business analysts, developers, testers, support teams and leaders to ensure projects are properly planned, progress is clearly communicated and risks are addressed early.

This is a newly created role reporting to the Managing Director, and you would be our first dedicated project manager, shaping how projects are planned and delivered across the business from the ground up. The role has no direct reports and will cover a broad mix of work, from smaller operational improvements and software enhancements through to larger cross-functional projects and strategic initiatives. Some projects may involve coordinating a handful of contributors, while others may span multiple teams and business areas.

About Us

We are a certified Great Place to Work for 2024, 2025 and 2026, with a culture grounded in collaboration, learning and autonomy. Our remote-first model allows all employees to work from home, with the option to hot desk at our Varsity Lakes office for those living locally. We focus on practical support, flexibility and meaningful professional development.

What the role involves

Project Planning and Delivery

  • Manage software development and internal business projects from kick-off through to release or implementation.

  • Projects may range from small enhancements and process improvements through to larger software initiatives involving multiple teams.

  • Work with product owners, business analysts, developers and stakeholders to agree on project scope, objectives and success measures.

  • Build and maintain project plans, timelines, resource requirements and delivery schedules.

  • Coordinate project activities across development, testing, support and other areas of the business.

  • Manage dependencies and coordinate work across multiple projects, escalating priority conflicts where required.

  • Monitor progress against agreed milestones and address delays, risks and blockers early.

  • Support the release and rollout of new software features, enhancements and system changes.

Project Coordination and Communication

  • Maintain a clear and accurate register of projects underway across MaxSoft.

  • Apply the level of project planning, documentation and oversight appropriate to the size, risk and complexity of each project.

  • Maintain accurate project plans, status reports, risk registers and decision records.

  • Facilitate project meetings, planning sessions, reviews and stakeholder updates as required.

  • Provide clear updates to leadership on project status, timelines, resourcing and risks.

  • Ensure changes to project scope, priorities or timelines are documented and communicated.

  • Present project information and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Participate in occasional client or external stakeholder discussions where project delivery input is required.

Leadership and Continuous Improvement

  • Provide leadership to project teams and contributors without direct reporting authority.

  • Build strong working relationships across product, development, testing, support and other areas of the business.

  • Guide contributors, follow up agreed actions and work with stakeholders to keep projects moving.

  • Promote accountability, collaboration and clear communication within project teams.

  • Identify opportunities to improve project delivery, reporting, tools and ways of working.

  • Assist team members in understanding and adopting improved project practices.

  • Use AI tools appropriately to support project planning, delivery, reporting and administration.

  • This is a hands-on role where you'll be expected to coordinate delivery, follow up actions, solve problems and keep momentum across projects rather than simply report on project status.

What you bring

  • Senior-level project management experience in software development, SaaS, technology or a similar environment.

  • Experience managing software or technology projects from initial planning through to release or implementation.

  • A healthy balance of business understanding and technical knowledge.

  • Confidence working with product owners, business analysts, developers, testers and other technical specialists.

  • The ability to manage multiple projects, changing priorities and competing deadlines.

  • Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills.

  • The ability to build effective working relationships and influence people who do not report directly to you.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, decision-making and prioritisation skills.

  • The ability to identify project risks early and take appropriate action.

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.

  • Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical audiences.

  • High attention to detail and a resilient approach in a fast-paced environment.

  • The ability to learn quickly across different products, technologies and business areas.

  • Experience establishing or improving project delivery processes, tools and reporting.

  • Confidence using AI tools to support project management and delivery.

  • Familiarity with Agile, Scrum or hybrid project delivery methodologies.

Experience in strata management, property services or property technology would also be beneficial but is not required.

Eligibility and Additional Information

Applicants must be Australian Citizens or Permanent Residents living in Australia.

Because our software supports trust account and financial processes in the strata industry, MaxSoft has obligations under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act. Background screening is therefore a condition of employment, and may include identity verification, reference checks, criminal history checks, immigration checks, verification of academic qualifications and bankruptcy checks.

What you can expect:

  • A remote-first work environment that supports work-life balance.

  • A varied role combining software project delivery, internal business projects and process improvement.

  • The opportunity to contribute to how projects are planned and managed across MaxSoft.

  • A supportive team environment with access to experienced technical and business professionals.

  • Opportunities to broaden your knowledge of software development, business operations and the strata management industry.

  • The opportunity to work closely with experienced leaders and contribute directly to how projects and initiatives are delivered across the business.

How to Apply

Submit your resume and a cover letter via SEEK, detailing your experience and how your skills align with this role. Highlight your experience managing software or technology projects, coordinating work across multiple teams and improving project delivery processes.

If you’re passionate about software project delivery and enjoy combining planning, communication and problem-solving, we’d love to hear from you.

At the Gold Coast Convention and Exhibition Centre (GCCEC), technology plays a critical role in both the day-to-day operation of our business and the successful delivery of major conferences, exhibitions and events.


Looking for and IT support role that goes beyond resetting passwords and working through a ticket queue?

We’re looking for an IT Service Operations Analyst to join our IT team and provide high-quality technical support across both environments. One day you might be helping a team member with Microsoft 365 or troubleshooting an endpoint issue; the next, you could be preparing network services for an upcoming event or helping resolve a technical issue while that event is live.

It’s an ideal opportunity for someone with a foundation in IT support who wants to broaden their technical skills, gain exposure to enterprise and event technology, and build their career as part of a modern IT team.

 

THE ROLE

Reporting to the IT Manager and working closely with our Service Operations and Platform Engineering functions, you’ll provide Level 1 and Level 2 IT support to GCCEC team members while also helping deliver IT services for events held at the Centre.

You’ll work across end user support, Microsoft 365, identity and access management, networking and endpoint technologies, while gaining hands-on exposure to the infrastructure and services required to support a busy convention and exhibition venue.

A significant point of difference is event IT delivery. You’ll help prepare and configure IT services for the world class events held at GCCEC, complete readiness checks, deploy services in accordance with established designs and runbooks, and provide technical support when events are underway. 

This is a hands-on role where good technical skills matter, but so do customer service, attention to detail and the ability to remain composed when an issue needs to be solved quickly.


What you’ll be doing

  • Providing Level 1 and Level 2 support across end user technology, applications, Microsoft 365, identity and collaboration platforms
  • Managing incidents and service requests from initial contact through to resolution or escalation
  • Troubleshooting endpoint, application, connectivity and access issues
  • Assisting with the preparation, configuration and deployment of IT services for conferences and events
  • Completing pre-event technical readiness checks to make sure services are ready when our clients need them
  • Providing on-site and remote IT support during live events
  • Working with networking technologies including wired and wireless connectivity
  • Following established processes, standards and runbooks to deliver consistent, reliable services
  • Maintaining accurate support records, asset records, technical documentation and knowledge articles
  • Identifying recurring issues and opportunities to improve the way we deliver IT services
  • Working alongside experienced IT professionals and contributing to the continued development of our service management practices

 

ABOUT YOU

You don’t need to know everything already. We’re looking for someone with a solid technical foundation, a strong customer-service mindset and, importantly, the curiosity and drive to keep developing.

You’ll ideally bring experience in an IT support, Helpdesk or service delivery environment, together with exposure to technologies such as:

  • Windows desktop and server environments
  • Microsoft 365 and collaboration tools
  • Active Directory and/or Microsoft Entra ID
  • Endpoint management
  • Basic networking, including switching, wireless and connectivity troubleshooting
  • A tertiary qualification in Information Technology or a related discipline is desirable, although equivalent practical experience is equally relevant.
  • Experience supporting events, venue technology, or IT service management processes would be an advantage, but isn’t essential. 
  • More importantly, you’ll be someone who communicates well, enjoys helping people, pays attention to the details and can work methodically under pressure. You’ll be comfortable following established processes while also speaking up when you see an opportunity to make something better.

Full Australian working rights are required for this position in addition to a probity check.


Why join GCCEC?

This isn’t your typical IT support environment.

You’ll work in a venue where technology supports both a corporate workplace and live events, giving you exposure to a much broader range of technology and operational scenarios than you might encounter in a conventional Helpdesk role.

You’ll join an IT team that is building a more structured, service-focused operating model, with clear processes, modern technology and opportunities to learn from experienced technical specialists.

For someone looking to establish or accelerate their IT career, the breadth of the environment provides an excellent opportunity to develop skills across end-user computing, Microsoft 365, identity, networking, service management and event technology.

And because we’re an events business, you’ll get to see the outcome of your work first-hand: technology that you helped prepare and support being used to deliver real events for our clients and guests.

 

Ready for your next step?

If you’re passionate about technology, enjoy solving problems and want an IT role with more variety than the traditional Helpdesk, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply now to join the IT team at the Gold Coast Convention and Exhibition Centre.

 

WHY WORK WITH US?  “It’s not what we do, it’s how we do it”! 

 

We pride ourselves on our values of Community, Initiative, Respect, Teamwork and Welcoming.  These values sit at the heart of how we work, how we treat our people, represent our business and deliver outstanding events. 

 

Plus, we offer the following people perks:

  • Free undercover parking in the heart of Broadbeach

Who we are

We're Yakk. A performance-driven digital marketing agency on the Gold Coast, made up of strategists, creatives and straight-talkers, with the occasional office dog wandering through. We build strong brands, run ads that actually work, and deliver marketing that gets results, not just reports.

  • Analyse client requirements and break a site down into the pages it needs

  • Identify the specific features, functionality, or technical considerations each build calls for

  • Scope approximate design and development hours per page, plus any other site elements as needed

  • Schedule all projects so timelines and pipelines are clear across the team

  • Support the paid media team with landing page development and scheduling accordingly

What you'll bring

Skills & Experience 

  • 3+ years managing web and SEO projects in an agency

  • 3+ years of managing clients' communications and expectations in an agency

  • Hands-on familiarity with WordPress and Elementor, enough to make straightforward changes directly and to speak credibly with both developers and clients

  • Comfortable making straightforward changes across Shopify and email marketing platforms (Mailchimp, Klaviyo, HubSpot), or a willingness to get up to speed on them quickly

  • A solid grasp of the web build lifecycle (design → development → content → QA → launch) and what each stage needs to keep moving

  • Comfortable working with hosting and staging environments (e.g. WP Engine), including the difference between staging and live

  • Able to read a design file (Figma) and translate it into a clear scope of pages, features, and estimated hours

  • Strong documentation habits that keep project records current, so anyone can see exactly where a project stands

  • Experience managing clients directly: setting expectations, obtaining and chasing approvals, and handling the occasional tricky conversation

  • Able to coordinate across development, design, and paid media, keeping everyone working to the same timeline

  • Ability to manage billing and invoicing for clients relating to web builds, support, hosting, or EDMs

  • Up to speed with the latest developments in AI for web, and able to put them to practical use, such as using tools like Claude to prototype or build out basic websites and speed up delivery

Attributes & Approach

  • A willingness to help evolve the role into a more structured, process-driven function, improving consistency, setting clearer client expectations, and making delivery more reliable

  • Highly organised, able to juggle multiple concurrent projects without letting detail slip

  • Proactive and takes ownership, chasing things down rather than waiting to be asked

  • A clear, confident communicator who can translate technical detail into plain language for clients

  • Calm under competing deadlines, with sound judgement on what to prioritise when everything feels urgent

  • Detail-oriented enough to spot the gap between what was scoped and what was built before the client does

  • Commercially aware, protecting project scope and margins, and flagging scope creep early

What Good Looks Like

  • Clients always know what's happening next and by when

  • The development team is briefed clearly and never left blocked waiting on missing information or decisions

  • Builds match what was scoped and approved, because they've been checked before they reach the client
